mapper.select: SELECT et.ticket_no, et.order_no, et.ticket_index, p.title AS program_title, p.place, ps.session_name, ps.show_time, tc.category_name, o.unit_price, et.ticket_status, et.verify_time, et.create_time FROM d_electronic_ticket et JOIN d_order o ON o.order_no = et.order_no JOIN d_program p ON p.id = et.program_id JOIN d_program_session ps ON ps.id = et.session_id JOIN d_ticket_category tc ON tc.id = et.ticket_category_id WHERE et.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY et.create_time DESC, et.ticket_index ASC
